widgets.title: Where should your business start?
widgets.use: General entry point. Good on the homepage, the Resources menu and the first slide of any proposal.

widgets.title: How fast does a new lead hear back?
widgets.use: RevOps discovery calls and the speed-to-lead section of any proposal.

widgets.title: Can you see what your marketing does?
widgets.use: Any proposal kickoff slide, or the onboarding email. Most clients score lower than they expect.

widgets.title: How many hours does hand work cost your team?
widgets.use: Sales calls and RevOps proposals. The one number makes the case for automation.

widgets.title: Is your Google Ads account ready to spend?
widgets.use: Paid media proposals and PPC landing pages. Surfaces setup gaps before a client pays for management.

widgets.title: Is Google Ads learning from the right results?
widgets.use: Paid media audits and kickoff calls, before anyone debates bids or budgets.

widgets.title: Which Google Ads campaign should you run first?
widgets.use: First paid media calls with new advertisers deciding where to start.

widgets.title: Can Google and AI search find your site?
widgets.use: SEO and AI SEO proposals, blog sidebars, and the AI SEO service page.

widgets.title: Are you ready to show up in local search?
widgets.use: Multi-location and local service prospects; the Local SEO service page.

widgets.title: How healthy are your Google reviews?
widgets.use: Local businesses, reputation conversations and the Local SEO page.

widgets.title: Could you say yes to a journalist this week?
widgets.use: Digital PR proposals and thought-leadership pages. Shows what a client must have ready before pitching starts.

widgets.title: Is your media kit ready for a journalist?
widgets.use: Digital PR proposals, after the pitch-ready check.

widgets.title: Are you ready to be a podcast guest?
widgets.use: Thought-leadership and PR conversations; pairs with a Sweet Takes invite.

widgets.title: Will your emails reach the inbox?
widgets.use: Email marketing proposals, ecommerce pages and onboarding. Since Google and Yahoo tightened bulk-sender rules, most lists have a gap here.

widgets.title: Which emails should be sending themselves?
widgets.use: Email and ecommerce calls: shows the automations a business is missing.

widgets.title: Is your email program healthy?
widgets.use: Email audits and renewals, especially for list-heavy senders.

widgets.title: Are you solving the right marketing problem?
widgets.use: Opening a strategy conversation: what problem are we really solving?

widgets.title: Which marketing foundation do you fix first?
widgets.use: Scoping calls: what already exists, and what to fix first.

widgets.title: Would your customers recommend you?
widgets.use: Client experience and retention conversations; post-sale check-ins.
